label: Header 2
description: Header 2 Standard 2-pin 0.1 header. Use with straight break away headers (SKU : PRT-00116), right angle break away headers (PRT-00553), swiss pins (PRT-00743), machine pins (PRT-00117), and female headers (PRT-00115). Molex polarized connector foot print use with SKU : PRT-08233 with associated crimp pins and housings.
